index_title: Guarded lift equivalence, exact idempotent envelopes and literal OLD seams
scope: Private B057: EIGHT source15 results, EIGHT equations with the explicitly CORRECTED TV1 guarded/RAW formula, eleven definitions, 72 human claims and nine tasks. Global guarded completion equivalence is proved via actual one-/two-generated reflection and binary irreducible local cover. Literal OLD term equations telescope before any completion. A nonempty strong idempotent has direct RAW envelope R_w;R_w=Id union e represented by ww, without CCO or NR2; MI reconstruction is separate. CCO-free full idempotent lattice/monolith is distinguished from its CCO distributive specialization. Branch visibility is repaired because a STRONG diversity menu is not literally RAW bisaturated when real diagonal pairs can be added: use its full restored pullback and guarded saturation, then fresh SAP neighbours. The desired kernel/old-equation conclusions remain valid. Higher-support clauses retain separate scope.
scope_explanation: statement and proof. D is a diversity-only menu; Dhat is its actual full root pullback and may contain real Id. TV1 is exported only with its recorded repair. Strong e is irreflexive; the equivalence is E_e=Id union e. Source16 old-gap certificates and factorisation forests are not imported.

assumptions.name: Actual original finite typed homogeneous source
assumptions.statement: M is countable homogeneous and complete in a finite binary relational language, with nonempty transitive named real sorts, finite actual pair orbitals, symmetric same-sort atoms and typed converses. All invariant same-sort relations are symmetric unions of actual old orbitals. Logical equality is separate from diversity.

assumptions.name: Original visible SAP
assumptions.statement: The original finite complete age has SAP over every complete old base. It gives pinned positive-word injectivisation, infinite old neighbour fibres, distinct representative splitting and fresh private interiors. No hidden SAP or CCO is inferred from SAP alone.

assumptions.name: Separate semantic CCO input
assumptions.statement: Original semantic homomorphic CCO supplies the prior exact-ball/finite distributive exact-lattice calculus and its full terminal specialization when used. It is NOT a premise of the direct ww envelope or the CCO-free idempotent lattice branch.

assumptions.name: FULL original NR2 terminal input
assumptions.statement: On each named real sort every proper original invariant relative index is infinite; in particular no index-two interval exists. This is checked on the FULL invariant lattice. It supplies prior RAW words and terminal named MI coordinates; no assumption that all generic invariant quotients are named is made.

assumptions.name: Actual MI-only hidden signature
assumptions.statement: The actual hidden interpretation has original real sorts and proper NONZERO represented MI quotient sorts, all actual complete pair orbitals and named projections/upward maps/quotient transitions/inverses. Functions are actual equivariant quotient maps and only unary. Relation arities are positive and at most two in the binary core; no nullary generators or quotient-to-real functions.

assumptions.name: Admissible partial source with actual joined support tests
assumptions.statement: C is finite, unary-functionally closed and unary-admissible. Its one-generated diagrams and every ACTUALLY joined irreducible old endpoint-pair support used by the guarded lift are full actual completed induced members. All constraints on one pair arise from that SAME support, as B056. The construction reaches a nonempty exact menu for each issued pair; no global completion is assumed.

assumptions.name: Optional higher-support interface
assumptions.statement: The binary conclusions are unconditional under their displayed inputs. An original finite-arity extension additionally freezes complete canonical old higher-support factors and assumes the separate support-normal completion/reflection interface. Binary pair closure and anchors alone do not imply higher-tuple reflection.

assumptions.name: Abstract literal unary seam context
assumptions.statement: Independently C is functionally closed under the named total unary maps. Every displayed macro-side equation is already a literal equality of OLD source term values. At a shared root both incident readings use the SAME canonical coordinate term, or an already literal named transition equality. No accidental equality of distinct completion images may be used as a seam.

imports.statement: Every constrained pair is supported by ONE actually irreducible locally completed old closure and has one actual common fine atom in ALL its profiles. No global C completion or Helly manufacturing of that witness.

imports.statement: In a binary/total-unary partial source, actual singleton and displayed two-endpoint closed supports cover every pair of vertices in a NONEMPTY irreducible; induced embeddings on these supports give HE on every irreducible, with the explicit empty/nullary convention. A05 positive arities discharge the empty gate.

definitions.name: Actual guarded visible lift
definitions.statement: G_typ(C) has one designated real witness per old hidden vertex, private positive theta bundles for nonempty actual pair menus, and full named root signatures. A visible completion here is induced/injective on this whole formal visible graph.

definitions.name: Whole irreducible source reflection
definitions.statement: A hidden completion is a homomorphism that embeds every induced closed irreducible source subobject. It need not be globally injective on reducible C.

definitions.name: Literal shared OLD seam
definitions.statement: At consecutive macro sides both incident coordinates are the same value of one canonical OLD source unary term at the shared formal root. Target coincidences of different source vertices are not seams.

definitions.name: Strong idempotent and its envelope
definitions.statement: e is a nonempty same-sort diversity-only positive word profile with e*e=e. E_e=Id union e is the actual reflexive relation; e itself is not an equivalence.

definitions.name: Equality-inclusive whole word relation
definitions.statement: R_w is the actual RAW endpoint relation of ONE fixed positive original atomic word. Its off-diagonal part is e; it may or may not contain the whole old diagonal.

definitions.name: Represented exact MI reconstruction
definitions.statement: MI is taken in the finite lattice of represented FULL RAW exact equivalences when reconstructing E_e, not in an arbitrary unproved invariant subfamily. Empty meet means Top.

definitions.name: Idempotent lattice and monolith
definitions.statement: I_a contains nonempty positive same-sort strong idempotents. L_a is the actual least nonidentity original invariant equivalence; e0=L_a^circ. Its unit action is asserted only on I_a.

definitions.name: Full restored menu versus diversity guard
definitions.statement: For the complete local hidden pattern let Dhat be its actual FULL representative-pair pullback, intersecting all actual term-comparison relations before deleting real Id. D=Dhat restricted to distinct original endpoints. Dhat is H_b,H_c-bisaturated; D generally is NOT literally RAW bisaturated.

definitions.name: Visible root coordinate
definitions.statement: H_b=Id for a real old root, or its proper represented MI kernel for a quotient old root. If H_b<=J, the J-coordinate is the real projection F_J or the named upward map from b.

definitions.name: Old source branch equation
definitions.statement: A quotient-functional positive branch P containing D induces an existing named atomic quotient transition, and its coordinate equation is reflected from ONE actual embedding of the same complete old source support.

definitions.name: Private whole-word obligation
definitions.statement: An obligation is ONE particular original atomic word with prescribed DISTINCT old endpoints whose actual fine pair atom is in its genuine strong profile; all its internal formal positions must be fresh.

claims.statement: Each private branch remains its exact positive old atomic path in a visible completion. Its prescribed root fine atom therefore lies in its genuine endpoint profile. Intersecting gives c in D for every guarded pair.

claims.statement: Membership in an equivalence diversity profile forces a projection/upward equality; I05 forces semantic cylinders, I06 forces nontrivial transition graphs and a singleton preserves an old fine atom. claims.statement: At each represented J with DDop subset J, the actual completed atom c lies in D and in every defining branch. I06 strict C45 support identifies canonical maps/kernels for all quotient-functional relations containing c. Thus all direct and branch root equations hold on their literal actual quotients.

claims.statement: The actual named functions compose, invert and commute with upward maps as already interpreted. Once C03 holds, every stored named functional consequence is an equality of the same actual term values. No independent completion chart or fresh quotient map is chosen.

claims.statement: A finite completed hidden target is actual. Retain its real part and choose one real preimage for every proper quotient vertex; their finite induced old visible carrier has a full hidden expansion containing the target. Compose the original HE map with that inclusion.

claims.statement: Apply I03 to C05. All old real source witnesses and designated proper coordinate representatives may be chosen pairwise distinct, and all displayed unary/cylinder/old pair data stay true. Every imposed comparison then lies in its actual menu by I01/I02.

claims.name: Insert all private paths over their complete pinned old pair
claims.statement: For each fixed actual root pair with atom in D, its atom lies in each positive branch profile. Choose a fully simple old realization of that EXACT word and align its fine pair by old homogeneity. Repeated old SAP over the complete root pair adds all interiors fresh, preserving the prior entire old base.

claims.name: Hidden completion gives a visible completion of the lift
claims.statement: After finite C07 insertions, the finite complete old target realizes every branch and all designated roots. The formal vertices are all distinct, so it is a visible completion of G_typ(C). This is the binary direction; higher factors retain A07 separately.

claims.name: A visible completion canonically defines the source hidden map
claims.statement: Map an old real vertex to its real witness and an old proper b in B_aJ to the actual J-class of its designated real witness. C02-C04 preserve every displayed unary equation, cylinder, old atom and full root signature. No global source injectivity is presumed.

claims.name: One-generated valid diagrams embed in the canonical interpretation
claims.statement: A06 provides the FULL actual one-generated type. Original transitivity of each real/quotient root sort carries that one-root model to the chosen image; named equivariance determines all its term values. C09 function equations make the separately designated values agree, so the whole one-generated diagram is preserved and reflected.

claims.name: Joined two-root supports embed for EVERY chosen target atom
claims.statement: For every actual displayed joining endpoint pair, C01 puts its completed fine atom in D. I02 gives complete induced two-generated reflection, including all inequality/term-collision cases. This does not claim a reducible partial ancestor pair has one complete orbit.

claims.name: Binary local cover upgrades the small checks to every irreducible
claims.statement: Apply I04 to the source homomorphism C09 and local embeddings C10/C11. Every pair in a nonempty irreducible lies in one actual one-/two-generated displayed support, so all vertex collisions and binary relation reflection are controlled on that support. Positive arities A05 discharge the empty/nullary gate.

claims.statement: C12 proves induced injectivity/reflection on EVERY irreducible source substructure. With C09 homomorphism preservation this is exactly a hidden completion. For arity>=3 the independent frozen higher-support reflection interface is required; the binary proof does not assert it automatically.

claims.statement: C01-C04 prove every visible completion realizes all positive/signature data. C08/C13 give hidden completion iff visible completion, hence hidden noncompletion implies lift noncompletion. Binary proof uses no later forest or bounded-obstruction theorem. Conditional higher-support interpretation retains A07.

claims.name: Every OLD term equation has values inside C
claims.statement: Under A08, unary functional closedness retains every named term value. Each macro-side equation is literal in C before any completion. Its values do not depend on representative choices.

claims.name: The intermediate seam is one literal coordinate value
claims.statement: The hypotheses identify the incoming and outgoing readouts at the same OLD formal root as the SAME canonical term value, or supply an already literal named unary connecting equality. This supplies genuine substitution in C.

claims.name: Finite substitution telescopes the OLD equations
claims.statement: Induct on m. At the next side replace its source term by C16 and substitute the previous composite equation. This yields (pi_m composed...composed pi_1)(tau_0(b_0))=tau_m(b_m) inside C. Empty chain is its literal identity base case.

claims.name: No shared real vertex or amalgamation of supports is needed
claims.statement: C17 only uses equality of OLD named unary term values. Successive locally complete supports may intersect only in proper quotient coordinates; no same real representative or amalgamation of the supports enters this proof.

claims.name: Target coincidence of distinct old vertices cannot supply a seam
claims.statement: A HE map of a reducible source can identify vertices in different irreducible factors. Such an equality in a target is not literal source equality and cannot be substituted in C17. A separately displayed old unary transition can connect values only by its actual old equation.

claims.name: Literal OLD-seam telescope source export
claims.statement: C15-C19 prove OSE under the precise same-coordinate seam premise. This is an abstract unary equality argument with no original SAP/CCO, lattice, hidden completion or global injectivity assumption.

claims.name: Id union a strong idempotent is an ACTUAL equivalence
claims.statement: For nonempty same-sort symmetric diversity e with e*e=e, E_e=Id union e is reflexive/symmetric. If xE_e yE_e z and vertices coincide, transitivity is immediate; if all three are distinct, the two e-edges and strong idempotence put their endpoint atom in e. Hence E_e is invariant equivalence, while e itself stays irreflexive.

claims.name: The whole RAW word has precisely e as diversity part
claims.statement: For the fixed positive word w with strong profile e, I09 pinned C01 support converts each RAW distinct-endpoint walk into a fully distinct word path over that same fine endpoint pair. Thus R_w restricted off real Id is e. Since the source sort is transitive, the invariant diagonal part is either all Id or empty.

claims.name: The RAW whole word is symmetric and nontrivially serial
claims.statement: R_w is an original invariant same-sort relation, hence a union of symmetric orbitals by A01. A distinct witness exists since e is nonempty. Transitivity moves its first endpoint to every point, giving a distinct R_w-neighbour at each point. No CCO or terminality is used.

claims.name: Every true diagonal lies in the RAW square
claims.statement: For x choose y!=x with x R_w y by C23; symmetry gives y R_w x. Hence every (x,x) belongs to R_w;R_w. This is a genuine two-step RAW return, not a synthetic diversity equality letter.

claims.name: All off-diagonal RAW-square outputs stay in e
claims.statement: C22 gives R_w subset E_e, and C21 gives actual E_e transitivity. Thus R_w;R_w subset E_e; every distinct-endpoint output therefore lies in its diversity e.

claims.name: Strong idempotence supplies every e atom to the RAW square
claims.statement: Every actual e-atom belongs to e*e=e. Its strong two-edge witness has both incident relations in R_w by C22, so it lies in R_w;R_w. Original two-point homogeneity transports the witness to every actual pair of that atom.

claims.name: The direct RAW identity is represented by the literal word ww
claims.statement: C24-C26 give R_w;R_w=Id union e=E_e. Ordinary existential RAW composition is exactly the endpoint relation of the concatenated ORIGINAL word ww, so E_e is a singleton FULL RAW word profile and exact by definition. No prior exactness of every invariant equivalence is used.

claims.name: Direct idempotent-envelope subexport has no CCO or NR2 premise
claims.statement: C21-C27 prove actual E_e and the literal ww representation using old symmetry/transitivity, the strong idempotence and visible SAP injection only. It remains valid outside terminal/no-finite-cover and outside CCO.

claims.name: Apply the SEPARATE finite exact-lattice reconstruction theorem
claims.statement: Under original CCO exact-ball input, I10 gives the finite distributive lattice of represented FULL RAW exact equivalences with actual meets/Top. C27 first places E_e in that lattice. Its internal MI/Birkhoff reconstruction gives E_e=meet{represented proper MI J>=E_e}, including empty Top meet.

claims.name: Idempotent RAW exact-envelope source export
claims.statement: C28 gives the direct word identity and C29 its separate represented-MI reconstruction TF1. The statement is prepared without pretending the diversity profile e itself is reflexive or silently identifying all generic invariants with represented exacts.

claims.name: The envelope map is injective and order preserving
claims.statement: Every nonempty positive idempotent gives E_e>Id by C21. Removing Id recovers e exactly, so the map is injective; inclusion of profiles is equivalent to inclusion of their actual envelopes. This requires no CCO.

claims.name: Every nonidentity invariant equivalence has one positive diversity word
claims.statement: For original E>Id, A04 excludes every index-two interval and I11 gives a RAW atomic word for E. Remove any literal Id letters; the remaining word is positive since an all-Id word would represent Id. I09 pinned whole-word injection identifies its distinct-endpoint profile with E^circ.

claims.name: Equivalence reproduction makes that diversity word idempotent
claims.statement: I13 applies to nonidentity E under old SAP and gives E^circ*E^circ=E^circ. Combining with C32 proves surjectivity of the envelope map onto ALL original invariant E>Id, with no CCO input.

claims.name: Nonzero meets stay nonzero by the original SAP monolith
claims.statement: For E,F>Id, I12 makes E meet F>Id with infinite classes. Its diversity is e intersect f and is positive reachable/idempotent by C32/C33. Thus the idempotent meet is actual nonempty intersection; no zero diversity bottom is inserted.

claims.name: The idempotent join is the actual strong product
claims.statement: For nonzero old E,F, I09 gives E^circ*F^circ=(E;F)^circ=(E join F)^circ. The last relation is the actual original invariant join. Hence e join f=e*f, with no mixed-sort commutation or CCO assumption.

claims.name: The full idempotent family is a finite lattice
claims.statement: Finite original orbitals give a finite full invariant lattice. C31/C33 give an order isomorphism after removing Id, and C34 keeps this nonidentity part meet-closed. C35 supplies the join formula. Therefore I_a is a finite lattice with the stated actual operations.

claims.name: Its unique least nonzero element is the SAP monolith diversity
claims.statement: I12 provides the unique least nonidentity invariant L_a. C32/C33 make its diversity e0 positive/idempotent, and the order isomorphism makes it the unique least element of I_a, below every e.

claims.name: The monolith diversity is a unit INSIDE the idempotent lattice
claims.statement: For e corresponding to E>=L_a, C35 gives e0*e=(L_a join E)^circ=E^circ=e and similarly e*e0=e. No unit action is asserted on arbitrary reachable profiles or atomic colours.

claims.name: CCO-free lattice and monolith conclusions are complete
claims.statement: C31-C38 prove the order bijection, nonempty meets, strong-product joins and monolith unit for a symmetric old SAP+FULL NR2 source. No original CCO, exact-ball Helly, distributivity or hidden SAP enters this branch.

claims.name: Distributivity is the separate extra-CCO specialization
claims.statement: If original CCO is ALSO assumed, A04 and I14 make the FULL invariant lattice distributive. Its nonidentity part is meet-closed by C34, so the isomorphic idempotent lattice is distributive. The source export comprises C39 plus this conditional specialization; the G5 interval envelope is E_e, not automatically L_a.

claims.name: Restore the FULL actual root-pullback relation before saturation
claims.statement: For a complete locally valid old endpoint pattern, every mandatory term comparison pulls back to a FULL relation factoring through the actual H_b and H_c classes. Their intersection Dhat is H_b,H_c-bisaturated. Its diversity restriction is exactly the guarded menu D. Dhat can contain the real diagonal; D never does.

claims.name: Correct TV1 is guarded saturation, not a false RAW equality
claims.statement: From C41 and reflexivity, D subset H_b;D;H_c subset Dhat; therefore (H_b;D;H_c)^circ=D. The printed RAW H_b;D;H_c=D is false in general: projection to J has D=J^circ,H_b=Id,H_c=J and J^circ;J=full J, including Id. Only the corrected equation is exported.

claims.name: Every nonempty old diversity relation has infinite neighbour fibres
claims.statement: Choose any atom t in D and one witnessed t-edge x-y. Repeated old SAP copies of the complete pair over x give arbitrarily many distinct target neighbours, all retaining t; homogeneity/transitivity gives the same at every source. Converse gives infinite predecessor fibres. This supplies avoidance of finitely many possible coincident endpoints.

claims.name: Fresh neighbours repair the source-kernel visibility proof
claims.statement: For x H_b xprime choose y in D[x] with y!=xprime, possible by C43 (and x!=y because D is diversity). Full Dhat left saturation C41 gives xprime Dhat y; distinctness gives xprime D y. Since D subset P both incident pairs lie in P, so x(P;Pop)xprime and hence x J xprime. Thus H_b<=J without falsely assuming D itself RAW bisaturated.

claims.name: Fresh predecessors repair target-kernel visibility
claims.statement: For y H_c yprime choose x in D^-1[y] with x!=yprime by C43. C41 right saturation gives x Dhat yprime, and distinctness gives x D yprime. Both are P-edges, so y(Pop;P)yprime. Since J is reflexive, Pop;P subset Pop;J;P=J^P by I15. Thus H_c<=J^P.

claims.name: The visible coordinates and branch map are ALREADY named terms
claims.statement: For a real old root use F_J. For a proper root H_b<=J gives its named upward quotient; C45 gives the target upward map too. I08 identifies the quotient map of P with any actual fine t subset P and makes J^P a named proper MI under FULL terminality/noncollapse. No auxiliary representative-dependent coordinate symbol is introduced.

claims.name: The checked complete old factor reflects its branch equation
claims.statement: A06 supplies ONE actual embedding of the source support. Choose distinct real representatives by I03; its actual pair atom lies in D subset P by I01. Canonical quotient transport therefore gives pi_PJ(tau_J(b))=tau_JP(c) in that realization. As both sides are named OLD term values, induced injectivity reflects their equality back to C.

claims.name: Branch-root visibility source export WITH TV1 repair
claims.statement: C44/C45 prove H_b<=J,H_c<=J^P; C46/C47 give the literal named old-root equation. The full RAW restatement is H_b;Dhat;H_c=Dhat, and the actual STRONG restatement is C42. The desired TV2/conclusions need no added assumption; their proof uses oldSAP freshness to repair the printed TV1 error.

claims.name: Each branch under discussion has ACTUAL OLD source endpoints
claims.statement: I16 locates its root witnesses at the original source vertices b,c. By A06 their constraints belong to one already checked one-generated or genuinely irreducible two-generated old support; no equation is synthesized on an unconstrained ancestor pair.

claims.name: A total exact meet inside P is sufficient for branch visibility
claims.statement: The repaired C48 applies to D_bc subset P and actual H_b,H_c. It does NOT require any primitive defining profile of D_bc to have J-functional fibres; only the particular branch P under consideration satisfies PP^op subset J.

claims.name: Use one full local realization for the ENTIRE pair menu
claims.statement: The complete source support has one actual embedding, not separately selected models per constraint. I03 provides distinct representatives inside one finite old visible expansion covering that factor. I01 supplies their one fine atom t in EVERY imposed profile and hence t in D_bc subset P.

claims.name: Canonical quotient transport forces the branch equation there
claims.statement: C50 gives named tau_J(b),tau_JP(c) and an existing atomic representative of pi_PJ. The actual P-edge witnessed in C51 satisfies this canonical quotient map, so TOE holds in that one full hidden realization.

claims.name: Induced old-support embedding reflects equality of named term values
claims.statement: The source support is functionally closed and its realization is an EMBEDDING. Both sides of TOE are images of named unary term values already in that source support; equality of images therefore implies equality of their actual old source vertices in C. Mere homomorphism preservation would not suffice.

claims.name: Original-source branch equation source export
claims.statement: C49-C53 prove TOE literally in C, including when D_bc is a meet whose primitive factors lack functional fibres. It applies only to actual source-supported gadgets; it does not depend on a later completion-selected atom or theta interior vertex.

claims.statement: For a positive whole word w with strong idempotent profile e, if actual roots x!=y satisfy xE_e y, their actual pair colour is a diversity atom in e. E_e membership alone would not give an e-colour if the roots coincided.

claims.name: Realize the EXACT original word at its pinned fine pair
claims.statement: By definition of the genuine strong profile, C55 supplies a simple old word realization with that fine endpoint atom. Old pair homogeneity places its two endpoints at the prescribed actual x,y. No replacement factor word, equality edge or return to the same point is used.

claims.name: SAP makes the private interior fresh over the whole complete base
claims.statement: Take the complete induced old finite structure of the simple word realization. Strongly amalgamate it with the already completed old base over their complete two-point endpoint substructure. All word interior vertices stay outside the entire prior base and all its specified atoms remain fixed.

claims.name: Off-diagonal idempotent reinsertion source export
claims.statement: C55-C57 realizes the entire original w over its distinct roots with all interiors new. No CCO or FULL terminality is needed once the idempotent word and correct actual endpoint atom are supplied.

claims.statement: For a finite list over complete old A, membership of col_A(p_i,q_i) in the genuine strong profile of the SPECIFIED word w_i gives a simple realization in a finite complete old structure W_i. Endpoint pair types agree, and p_i!=q_i is explicit.

claims.name: Align its complete endpoint pair without changing any old atom
claims.statement: Old named fine-pair homogeneity identifies the witness endpoints with literal p_i,q_i in A. The common two-point substructure is complete even when that pair also occurs in other obligations.

claims.statement: Strongly amalgamate the current complete old structure with W_i over its two pinned endpoints. Its other vertices are fresh from the whole current structure; every earlier interior and all original A pair colours remain fixed. New cross-interior colours are unrestricted, so overlapping endpoint pairs cause no problem.

claims.name: Finite induction gives one simultaneous finite complete extension
claims.statement: Start at A and apply C61 to each finite obligation. The final union lies in one finite complete old age member. All interiors are pairwise distinct, disjoint between words and from A; every prescribed endpoint pair and old base atom is retained literally. Empty obligation list returns A.

claims.name: Simultaneous original-word insertion source export
claims.statement: C59-C62 prove the literal original words can ALL be inserted over ONE complete old base by visible SAP. No CCO, idempotence, quotient naming or relation among new private interiors is required after the given endpoint-profile premises.

claims.name: Printed TV1 fails even for a basic projection equality
claims.statement: In an infinite equivalence source choose a proper coordinate J and its projection. For a real old root b and proper root c=F_J(b), distinct real representatives have menu D=J^circ with H_b=Id,H_c=J. RAW J^circ;J is fullJ because each class has at least two points, while D omits Id.
